label: Mechanistic Insights and Emerging Therapeutic Strategies in Recurrent Pericarditis.
summary: Recurrent pericarditis is a heterogeneous and often debilitating inflammatory disorder characterized by recurrent flares following a symptom-free interval of at least 4 to 6 weeks. Although most cases in developed countries are idiopathic or post-viral, the condition may arise from autoimmune disease, post-cardiac injury syndromes, infection, or systemic inflammatory disorders.
